description: This is a test source file for the Django e-commerce application, specifically testing the order lifecycle API endpoints and transition behaviors, including authorization, state transitions, idempotency, and inventory adjustments.

methods.name: test_user_orders_endpoints_are_user_scoped( api_client, item_factory, order_factory, obtain_jwt_tokens, user_password, user )
methods.description: Tests that each user can only access their own orders and cannot access others' orders.

methods.name: test_admin_orders_list_requires_admin(api_client, auth_headers_for_user)
methods.description: Verifies that listing admin orders requires proper admin authorization.

methods.name: test_admin_transition_paid_is_idempotent_and_creates_history_and_inventory( api_client, item_factory, order_factory, admin_user_in_group, auth_headers_for_admin, )
methods.description: Ensures that paying an order is idempotent, updates inventory, and creates proper history records.

methods.name: test_admin_transition_cancel_releases_reservation( api_client, item_factory, order_factory, auth_headers_for_admin, admin_user_in_group )
methods.description: Checks that canceling an order releases reserved inventory and updates order status.

methods.name: test_admin_transition_refund_restocks_and_is_idempotent( api_client, item_factory, order_factory, auth_headers_for_admin, admin_user_in_group )
methods.description: Verifies that refunding restocks inventory and that multiple refunds are idempotent.

methods.name: test_invalid_order_transition_returns_400( api_client, item_factory, order_factory, auth_headers_for_admin, admin_user_in_group )
methods.description: Confirms invalid status transitions return HTTP 400 error.
